name: Location Builder
description: Define a place's geography, function, access, and story use without writing canon. Field names are stable for future Canon mapping. This pack does not write canon, characters, locations, or factions. Workflow execution is not implemented.

stages.title: Identity
stages.intent: Name the place and the scenes it is built to host.

stages.title: Geography
stages.intent: Record scale, climate, and position relative to other places.

stages.title: Function
stages.intent: What people do here: home, market, fortress, ruin, workplace.

stages.title: Access Rules
stages.intent: Who may enter, who is watched, what is forbidden.

stages.title: Story Use
stages.intent: Conflicts this place makes easier or harder.

stages.title: Canon Review
stages.intent: Human review. This pack does not write location canon.
